content: RFP scoring: weighted criteria commonly technical approach/capability (30-40%), cost/value (20-25%), experience/references (15-20%), security/compliance (10-15%), implementation approach (10-15%). Compliance is a mechanical pass/fail gate checked before scoring; responsiveness (substantive answer quality) is where deals are actually won/lost during scoring. Executive summary is read in isolation during shortlisting, so it must independently prove buyer-specific understanding. Best structural convention: mirror the buyer's own numbering/terminology exactly, answer-first (direct answer, then detail, then evidence), one place per requirement.
